subject: Suncrest private offer — procurement runbook & billing onramp
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@suncrest.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Kline <tom.kline@suncrest.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suncrest MAP draft and procurement intake (AWS private offer)

Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is our initial ask and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) for the AWS private offer purchase. High level: Suncrest wants a phased evaluation (30-day pilot), followed by a committed private-offer purchase aligned to calendar Q4 spend and a monthly invoice flow for finance.

Attached: Suncrest_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone checklist).

Open questions from our side:
- Does Redwood accept a DocuSign PO for the private offer, or do we need to process via AWS Marketplace (PO + marketplace invoice)?
- Who at Redwood will own billing onboarding for a marketplace commit?
- Estimated date we can enable private-offer entitlement in our AWS account once the PO is signed.

Can you route to procurement/finance on your side and share a proposed milestone acceptance path? We’d like the pilot to start 9/1 and the committed private offer to be live by 9/20.

Best,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Suncrest AI

Attachment: Suncrest_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@suncrest.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Suncrest MAP draft and procurement intake (AWS private offer)

Alyssa —

Thanks for the MAP. Looks clear and aligned to the timeline you suggested. Quick answers up front:
- We can accept a DocuSign PO for Redwood Dedicated/private-offer commitments — that is our preferred route for enterprise deals.
- For AWS Marketplace private offers we coordinate entitlement with the marketplace team; we can support a marketplace PO route if Suncrest prefers marketplace invoicing.
- Billing onboarding will be owned by our Revenue Ops (cc'd: Neha). Procurement/Legal touchpoints: Priyom (legal) and Rishi (technical lead / onboarding) are looped.

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood to provide a one-page acceptance checklist (I’ll attach) that maps to your MAP milestones.
2) Suncrest to confirm whether you want marketplace invoicing or direct invoice to Redwood after PO.
3) If DocuSign PO flow: we will issue a DocuSign stub for signature and hand off to Neha for billing activation.

I’ll draft the acceptance checklist and share by EOD.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_acceptance_checklist_v1.docx (docx, 12KB stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Suncrest MAP draft and procurement intake (internal)

Team —

Read the MAP and Markus’s notes. A few operational items we need to lock before we send the DocuSign:
- Billing path: Suncrest should confirm marketplace vs direct invoice. If they choose marketplace private offer, we must provision listing entitlement with AWS and billing will be via AWS invoice (Suncrest pays AWS; AWS remits to Redwood) — longer lead time (~7–10 business days).
- Direct invoice: requires Net30 terms and PO number; finance to verify tax/AR contacts. Neha will need the official billing contact and remittance address.
- Currency/Tax: Suncrest is US-based; standard US tax handling applies.

Action items for Priyom: confirm any legal redlines on the PO template in the MAP spreadsheet; we should push for standard SOW/acceptance language in milestone 2.
Action for Rishi: is 30-day pilot instrumentation (prefix caching + KV warmup) something we can guarantee by 9/1 given our staging queue? If not, propose alternatives.

I’ll prepare the DocuSign PO stub and a short billing onboarding checklist.

-Neha
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Suncrest MAP draft and procurement intake (legal review)

Couple of notes after quick pass on Suncrest_MAP_v1.xlsx:
- PO acceptance: remove language that ties acceptance solely to "API latency under 150ms" — replace with "mutual acceptance criteria per test suite attached" to avoid performance SLA hard requirement during pilot.
- Add clause: Redwood reserves right to fallback to compatible model variant if capacity constrained; customer will be notified 24 hours in advance. Helps protect us for Dedicated pool scheduling.
- For commercial terms: suggest keeping initial pilot as non-billable evaluation, with milestone sign-off leading to committed spend.

If Suncrest insists on marketplace-only billing, we will add a 5–7 business day operational window to the MAP for entitlement.

-Priyom
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@suncrest.ai>, Tom Kline <tom.kline@suncrest.ai>, procurement@suncrest.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Redlined MAP + proposed acceptance runbook (Suncrest)

Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks — attaching a redlined MAP and the acceptance runbook that aligns to the timeline you suggested. Key points:
- Pilot start: 2026-09-01 — 30-day evaluation (non-billable).
- Milestone 1 (9/01): pilot enablement + smoke tests (Rishi owns).
- Milestone 2 (9/15): mutual acceptance / sign-off on test suite.
- Milestone 3 (9/20): PO executed -> private-offer entitlement enabled; billing activation within 48–72 business hours for direct invoice. If marketplace route is used, allow 7 business days for entitlement.

Attached: Suncrest_MAP_v1_redline.xlsx, Redwood_acceptance_checklist_v1.docx, DocuSign_PO_stub.pdf

Please confirm marketplace vs direct invoice by EOD Monday (8/24) so we can prepare the correct PO flow. If direct invoice, we’ll send DocuSign for signature; if marketplace, we’ll kick the marketplace entitlement flow.

—Markus
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Suncrest_MAP_v1_redline.xlsx; Redwood_acceptance_checklist_v1.docx; DocuSign_PO_stub.pdf (stubs)

From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@suncrest.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Kline <tom.kline@suncrest.ai>, procurement@suncrest.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redlined MAP + proposed acceptance runbook (Suncrest)

Markus —

Thanks for the clear runbook and redlines. We’ll go direct invoice (DocuSign PO) to keep finance flow simple. Tom/Procurement are aligned. Please send the DocuSign; procurement will sign and return by 9/10.

A couple of small asks from our side:
- Invoice frequency: monthly in arrears.
- PO number must appear on invoice and on the initial activation paperwork.
- Can you confirm the AR contact and email for Redwood? (we’ll add to our ERP).

I’ll attach our signed PO when it’s returned.

Best,
Alyssa

Attachment: (will provide signed PO via DocuSign)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Suncrest — PO received and billing activation

Team / Alyssa —

Received the signed PO from Suncrest (Suncrest_PO_signed_stub.pdf attached). AR details for Redwood: ar@redwoodinference.com, Redwood Inference, 1400 Market St, SF CA 94103. Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears, Net30.

Action items closed:
- DocuSign PO signed (attached).
- Rishi to enable pilot access on 2026-09-01 (confirmed).
- Neha to activate billing once PO is ingested (target within 48–72 hours of PO ingestion).

Alyssa — I’ll follow up with an activation email once billing is active. Looking forward to a smooth pilot.

-Neha
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Suncrest_PO_signed_stub.pdf (pdf, 18KB stub)
